annotations.title: Compute a tax figure with tested code

description:
Computes a tax figure with fixed, tested code instead of mental arithmetic. Use this for any figure an engine below covers; never compute that figure yourself. Pass only the facts the user gave: the engine applies the tax rules itself (allowances, standard deductions, bands, caps) and never asks you to decide a rule. Returns the result, every step, each rate used with its skill, section and quoted line, the engine's assumptions, skills_used with each skill's approval label (state it exactly as given) and a receipt id. Every engine takes tax_year and refuses a year it has no figures for. Facts marked * are required; an optional fact you leave out takes its default, and the answer states that as an assumption. If the engine returns missing_rule or needs_input, tell the user exactly what is missing or ask them for the fact. Never call again with guessed or altered facts to get a number, and never compute the figure yourself instead.
Engines:
- nl_vpb_2026 [NL]: Netherlands corporate income tax (vennootschapsbelasting) for 2026 on a BV/NV's taxable amount (after loss offset and exemptions). Facts: taxable_amount* (number), tax_year* (2026).
- uk_ani_pension_target_2026_27 [GB]: UK 2026-27: how much to pay (net) into a relief-at-source personal pension to bring adjusted net income down to a limit. Targets: personal_allowance_taper (GBP 100,000), child_benefit_charge_nil (GBP 60,000), tax_free_childcare (limit not served by any skill: always returns missing_rule until a skill serves it). Facts: total_taxable_income* (number), existing_gross_ras_contributions (number, default 0), gross_gift_aid (number, default 0), target* (personal_allowance_taper|child_benefit_charge_nil|tax_free_childcare), tax_year* (2026-27).
- uk_paye_take_home_2026_27 [GB]: UK employee annual income tax (rUK rates: England, Wales, Northern Ireland) and employee Class 1 NIC (category A) on salary for 2026-27, and take-home pay. Annual basis. Facts: annual_salary* (number), region* (england|wales|northern_ireland|scotland), nic_category (string, default A), other_income (number, default 0), gross_pension_contributions_ras (number, default 0), tax_year* (2026-27).
- ca_cpp_ei_employee_2026 [CA]: Canada (outside Quebec) employee CPP (base + first additional), CPP2 and EI premiums for a full calendar year 2026 with one employer. Facts: annual_pensionable_earnings* (number), province* (string), months_employed (number, default 12), tax_year* (2026).
- au_sbito_2026_27 [AU]: Australia 2026-27 small business income tax offset for an individual resident: 16% of the tax on net small business income, capped at $1,000, aggregated turnover under $5m. Facts: taxable_income* (number), net_small_business_income* (number), aggregated_turnover* (number), tax_year* (2026-27).
- au_resident_tax_2026_27 [AU]: Australia, resident for the full 2026-27 year: income tax on taxable income less LITO, plus 2% Medicare levy, plus MLS check; take-home = gross income less those. Facts: gross_income* (number), other_deductions (number, default 0), has_salary_or_wage_income* (boolean), actual_work_expenses_claimed (number, default 0), has_private_hospital_cover* (boolean), has_help_debt (boolean, default false), tax_year* (2026-27).
- ie_income_tax_usc_2026 [IE]: Ireland 2026: income tax (after personal + PAYE credits) and USC for a single PAYE employee for the full year, cumulative basis. Facts: gross_pay* (number), employee_pension_contribution (number, default 0), status* (string), age_70_or_full_medical_card (boolean, default false), tax_year* (2026).
- de_est_tariff_2026 [DE]: Germany 2026 income tax from the § 32a EStG tariff on taxable income (zu versteuerndes Einkommen), Grundtarif or splitting. Excludes solidarity surcharge and church tax. Facts: taxable_income_zve* (number), assessment* (single|joint), tax_year* (2026).
- pt_ss_independent_2026 [PT]: Portugal 2026: monthly social security contribution of a self-employed worker (quarterly regime) from the quarter's declared service/goods income; applies to the declaration month and the next two. Facts: quarter_services_income* (number), quarter_goods_income (number, default 0), is_eni_or_eirl (boolean, default false), base_adjustment_pct (number, default 0), exempt (boolean, default false), tax_year* (2026).
- us_se_tax [US]: US self-employment tax (Schedule SE regular method) for tax year 2025 or 2026: 92.35% of net profit, 12.4% social security up to the wage base less W-2 SS wages, 2.9% Medicare uncapped. Excludes the 0.9% Additional Medicare Tax (Form 8959). Facts: schedule_c_net_profit* (number), w2_social_security_wages (number, default 0), tax_year* (2025|2026).

engine.description: The engine name, from the list in this description (or start's `engine.name`).

facts.description: The engine's facts by name, e.g. {"annual_salary": 60000, "region": "england"}. Amounts are plain numbers in the engine's currency.

reason.description: One sentence on WHY you're making this call, in the user's terms (for routing analysis only). Optional.

name: compute

constants_used.description: name, value, slug, section, quote: each figure and the skill line it came from.

instruction.description: On a refusal: what to do next. Follow it.

receipt.description: id (sha256 of engine, version, facts and result), engine_version, computed_at.

result.description: label, value, currency and every computed line.

skills_used.description: slug, label ('Approved by [name]' or 'Not yet approved'), approval. Read live.

tax_year.description: The tax year the figures are for.

what.description: needs_input: the fact to ask for. missing_rule: the figure no skill serves.
